text:
sophie_support: FYI customer 'AcmeMobile' reporting repeated mid-stream disconnects during SSE chat responses. They see partial JSON chunks then TCP RST when user switches from WiFi -> cellular. Customer logs attached, asking if we should bill for partial outputs :thinking_face:
ben_dev: Can you paste the raw SSE output around the last chunk? also need the client connection id and whether token rotated midstream. Do we get a 401 or a socket close?
matt_acme: Pasting simplified output + client log. We get: `event: message
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}]}` then a few more data: chunks, then client shows `socket closed by peer` and app reconnects. No 401.
--- log snippet ---
[client] 2026-03-12T17:02:31Z GET /v1/stream 200
[client] chunk 1 received (10 bytes)
[client] chunk 2 received (42 bytes)
[client] network: interface change wlan0->rmnet_data0
[client] socket: FIN_WAIT -> RST (closed)
--- end ---
sophie_support: Customer says this happens when screen goes to background or when hotspot toggled. Happens mostly on Android carriers. They included pcap showing NAT keepalive gap ~70s.
infra-bot: Noted. NAT timeouts vary by carrier, many close idle TCP ~30-90s. If server pauses sending for that gap (e.g., no heartbeat between tokens), carrier may drop.
ben_dev: Do they send keepalive/newline chunks from client? SSE usually tolerant but many mobile NATs kill idle. We should confirm server pacing - if token refresh or batching delays >30s we need keepalive.
matt_acme: Client is simple: okhttp SSE wrapper, default read timeout 0, they don't send heartbeats. Server didn't push anything for ~65s before final partial chunk. Token TTL is 60s but token refresh happens via separate socket when they get a 401; not used here.
ingrid_oncall: Can we reproduce with a phone tether + traffic shaping? If we can repro we should collect: tcpdump from proxy, app-side pcap (Android), and our ingress LB logs with downstream connection id. Also need 'x-stream-client-id' header value.
ben_dev: Repro steps request: 1) Start SSE stream from Android client to our hosted API 2) Wait ~60-90s with no activity (app background or toggle WiFi) 3) Observe RST/FIN and partial JSON left in client buffer 4) Confirm no 401 or 502 from our side.
sophie_support: Customer asked about billing for partial responses — they were charged for tokens up to the last complete chunk but app didn't receive the final completion. Should we credit?
ben_dev: Policy: we bill for tokens served by the API (sent by server). If client didn't receive due to network, normally we don't refund. But UX-wise we should offer one-time goodwill for this customer. Escalate if systematic.
matt_acme: For immediate mitigation, any server-side knobs? Could we send keepalive `:
` comments every 15s for long streams or add heartbeat events?
infra-bot: We can enable `: keepalive` padding for specific customers via routing rules. Also infra recommends enabling TCP keepalive at the load balancer and setting idle timeout to 120s where possible. For mobile carriers under 60s this might still fail.
ben_dev: Also double-check our token refresh path: if clients rely on reauth mid-stream we should provide a streaming token header or pre-signed long-lived stream token to avoid reauth-related pauses.
ingrid_oncall: Action items: - sophie: get app pcap, client id header, and time windows. - matt: try reproducing with Android tether + throttle and send pcap + tcpdump. - infra: enable keepalive padding for AcmeMobile and monitor for 24h. - eng-runtime: consider adding optional `heartbeat_interval` param to SSE endpoint (server pings every N seconds).
sophie_support: I've requested PCAP + client id from AcmeMobile and offered a one-time credit while we triage. They accepted and will send artifacts. :white_check_mark:
ben_dev: For engineering triage: if reproducer shows NAT close, solution set = client keepalive + server heartbeat + LB idle adjustments + user-education. If we can add heartbeat param quickly, that may mitigate without client changes.
matt_acme: I'll try a quick app-side workaround: send a `: ping

` comment every 10s from client while waiting for completion and report back.
ingrid_oncall: If you cannot repro internally, escalate to eng-runtime with attached pcaps and ingress logs. Tagging @eng-runtime-run so they can scope a fix (server heartbeats + safe resends?).
ben_dev: One more note — avoid sending duplicate final completion if client reconnects and we re-deliver; instead provide idempotency keys so clients can resume safely. Suggest adding `stream-seq` header per chunk.
sophie_support: I'll keep thread updated when artifacts arrive. Thanks all. :pray:
infra-bot: Incident checklist created ID #INC-2026-1487 and assigned to ingrid_oncall.
ben_dev: ack.
--- end of thread ---
